title: Father's cornet and the family photograph
summary: Phillips recalls his father's brass cornet and says a sister has a photograph the interviewers hope to copy.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. What did he play? A cornet you say?
Yeah, a cornet. A real cornet. He had a loan about that size.
A real cornet. I can picture that thing. I was small but it was brass. It was brass, half of it was green.
Do you still have a picture of him?
No, my sister, one of my sisters have it. That would be wonderful. We could find that stuff and make a copy of it. I'd like to find it myself.
We could maybe make a copy of it. Yeah.
We could try to get it because he'll make a copy of it and give you one of it. Yeah.
And you can have the original back and we can all make copies from it then.
I would appreciate it. I mean they still do those old things away, you know, and they hide them and they bear them.
Very few people save those old pictures at the same time.
